essential_tweet_embeddings.tweet_text:
I'm realizing that when I try to aim to MAKE MORE MONEY, I feel selfish & grabby

but I feel more sane & Whole-some when I aim to HELP MORE PEOPLE, in sustainable ways

when I aim to CREATE MORE WEALTH, while capturing a similar fraction of the wealth I create as I do now

essential_tweet_embeddings.annotation: Viral Synthesis: Visa's 'practice and study' mega-thread exemplifying the mature form of obvious-saying—tautological wisdom that resonates because it names what people experience but don't articulate
